title: OVERRUN
description: A horde-survival arena FPS built in Three.js with no external assets: every texture, weapon, enemy rig and sound is generated in code. A 120x120 m industrial arena merged into ~100 draw calls, three weapon classes with red-dot and iron sights, patterned learnable recoil, hitscan ballistics with material penetration and per-part damage, and instanced procedural hordes with analytic hit spheres. Hand-rolled HDR pipeline: MSAA scene target, 13-tap down / tent-up bloom chain, and a single composite pass doing ACES, CAS sharpen, radial blur, chromatic aberration, anamorphic streak and damage grading. Lights are streamed through a fixed-size pool and resolution scales dynamically to hold 60 fps.
